g.text: The challenge is a server event.
The first client frame is connect.
Device identity and pairing support broad Gateway access.
The v1 AsyncAPI documents a token query parameter.
The baseline route shown here extracts only conversation_id.
There is no connect protocol negotiation.
No business query parameter and no URL token.
The connection cannot switch agent or conversation.
Unknown capabilities are ignored and not echoed.
Effective features do not replace request authorization.
